caller_tactics.text: Hello, Eszter? I'm Sam Okafor, an adviser with Corvin Lane Financial Advisers. We spoke at the library talk last spring. Is now a good time?
Thank you. You mentioned wanting a steady way to grow your savings without a lot of ups and downs.
Understood. Many of our customers choose a balanced fund for that reason. It holds a mix of shares and bonds.
The annual charge is about point eight percent of the amount invested. I'll put the exact figure in writing for you.
Yes. Its value can fall, especially in a bad year. That's why it works best for money you won't need for several years.
There's no set amount. Some people start with a few thousand, others with less, and you can add to it later.
That's a good idea. Many people find it helpful to include family in these decisions, and she's welcome to join a call with us.
I'll post it with the fee schedule this week. It's also available on the fund provider's website.
No. Nothing is needed from you today. Call me when you've had a chance to read it.
